import copy, json
from work import evaluate

def eq(actual, expected):
    assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)

base_req = {'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':{'x':[2,3]}}}
base_pol = {'required_conditions':['a','b'],'require_verified':False}

eq(evaluate(base_req,[{'source':'S','claim':'c','value':7,'conditions':copy.deepcopy(base_req['conditions'])}],base_pol), {'status':'supported','value':7,'sources':['S'],'unknowns':[]})
eq(evaluate({'claim':'c','conditions':{}},[],{'required_conditions':['z','a']}), {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['a','z']})
eq(evaluate(base_req,[{'source':'U','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':copy.deepcopy(base_req['conditions']),'verified':False}],{'required_conditions':['a','b'],'require_verified':True}), {'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
eq(evaluate(base_req,[{'source':'A','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':copy.deepcopy(base_req['conditions'])},{'source':'B','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':copy.deepcopy(base_req['conditions'])}],base_pol), {'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['A','B'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
eq(evaluate(base_req,[{'source':'A','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':copy.deepcopy(base_req['conditions'])},{'source':'B','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':copy.deepcopy(base_req['conditions']),'supersedes':['A']}],base_pol), {'status':'supported','value':2,'sources':['B'],'unknowns':[]})
eq(evaluate(base_req,[{'source':'F','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':copy.deepcopy(base_req['conditions'])}],base_pol), {'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['F'],'unknowns':[]})
req0=copy.deepcopy(base_req); ev0=[{'source':'M','claim':'c','value':{'k':[1]},'conditions':copy.deepcopy(base_req['conditions'])}]; pol0=copy.deepcopy(base_pol)
evaluate(req0,ev0,pol0)
assert req0==base_req and ev0==[{'source':'M','claim':'c','value':{'k':[1]},'conditions':base_req['conditions']}] and pol0==base_pol
requests=json.load(open('requests.json')); evidence=json.load(open('evidence.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json'))
assert report == [evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]
assert all(set(x)=={'status','value','sources','unknowns'} for x in report)
print('all checks passed')
